thread:
anna: During today's sampleapp run I noticed Go and TS SDKs surface different error keys, causing our onboarding smoke tests to flake.
kevin: Got an example?
anna: Yup. From the TS SDK for a generation 429: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "RateLimitError",
    "message": "request quota exceeded",
    "retry_after": 12
  }
}
```
oliver: And Go returned: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limited",
    "msg": "try later"
  }
}
```
neha: Oof. msg vs message, code vs type, and missing retry_after in Go.
tara: That breaks our sampleapp onboarding test that expects typed exceptions and a retry hint.
kevin: We should standardize both the schema and the SDK exception mapping. Proposal: top-level error keys: error.type (PascalCase), error.code (snake_case stable id), error.message (human text), error.retry_after (seconds or null), error.retry_hint (one of [none, exponential_backoff, fixed_delay]). Also include http_status at top-level for easy routing.
anna: I like explicit retry_hint for client-side behavior; retry_after is the HTTP-header value when present.
dev-bot: CI Note: sampleapp-onboard-smoke failed: go-sdk (1.18) produced mismatched error shape.
neha: Can we add an "error-shape-contract" test in sampleapp CI that runs the language samples, captures their error JSON for a forced 429 and validates keys + types?
kevin: Yes. Make it a blocking job for onboarding PRs. Add a small harness that hits /simulate-error?code=429 in the local dev server, collects responses from each SDK sample, and compares against a canonical JSON schema.
tara: Who owns the canonical schema?
neha: I can draft it and put it in devex/docs/error-shape.md. It will include mapping table: HTTP 429 -> RateLimitError (retry_after preferred, retry_hint=exponential_backoff), HTTP 503 -> TransientError (retry_hint=exponential_backoff), 401/403 -> AuthError (no retry), 400 -> BadRequest (no retry).
kevin: Also include sample mapping to raised SDK exceptions: TypeScript should produce classes (RateLimitError extends APIError with retryAfter property), Go should return typed error values with helpers: IsRateLimit(err) and RetryAfter(err) int.
anna: Small ergonomics ask: make the SDKs preserve both retry_after (int seconds) and retry_hint (string). Some clients only have one mechanism for delays.
tara: Onboarding copy: add clear copy for devs: "If you see RateLimitError, surface a retry UI and schedule retries using exponential backoff starting at 1s, cap 60s. Respect error.retry_after if set."
evan: (ping kevin) Can we include a brief telemetry label in the schema: error.code stable id so SRE can map errors across languages.
neha: yep, error.code is mandatory string.
kevin: Action items: 1) neha: draft canonical schema doc and example payloads. 2) anna: add error-shape-contract CI job + failing demonstration. 3) SDK owners: implement mapping and add tests. 4) devex: update onboarding quickstart to show handling patterns. I'll slot the RFC for discussion in next week's devex sync.
anna: I'll open the failing PR with the Go sample output so it's concrete for SDK owners.
kevin: Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: if anyone thinks the field names should be kebab-case or different casing, call it out now; otherwise we'll keep the mix: PascalCase type + snake_case code/retry_after for backwards compatibility.
neha: Leaning toward snake_case for machine fields, PascalCase only for typed names. I'll reflect that in the draft.
